prs.title: Move the scripting is disabled check for event handlers to compile time
prs.author: annevk
prs.body: Move the scripting is disabled check for event handlers to compile time Implementations block compiling an internal raw uncompiled handler, not invoking an event handler whose value is already a function. Also skip an event handler whose callback's global's associated Document is not fully active, matching DOM. prs.title: Read a media element's loading attribute after awaiting a stable state
prs.author: zcorpan
prs.body:
The parser appends attributes one at a time, so `<video src loading=lazy>` reached the resource
selection algorithm with `loading` still absent, was treated as Eager, and delayed the load event
until the video was scrolled into view.

Fixes #12854.

- [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed):
   * Bug fix to the recently added media `loading` attribute (#11980); Chromium already behaves this way.
- [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at:
   * web-platform-tests/wpt#62828
- [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed:
   * Chromium: not needed, Chrome Canary passes the test
   * Gecko: not needed, `loading` on media elements isn't implemented yet
   * WebKit: not needed, `loading` on media elements isn't implemented yet
- [x] Corresponding [HTML AAM](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/) & [ARIA in HTML](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/) issues & PRs: n/a
